Gurpreet Sinha | gurpreet.sinha119@example.com | +91 9771694754
Bengaluru
Notice period: 30 days

Professional Summary
Results-driven Business Development professional with experience in B2B Sales and lead generation across financial services and analytics sectors. Skilled in leveraging CRM systems and SFDC to manage pipelines, improve conversion rates, and coordinate cross-functional delivery using Confluence and Jira.

Technical Skills
B2B Sales, SFDC, Lead Generation, CRM, Confluence, Jira, Git

Work Experience

Business Development Manager, Saffron Bank (May 2024 - Present)
- Built and managed a targeted B2B Sales pipeline using SFDC, generating 120 qualified leads in Q2 and converting 18 into pilot engagements; coordinated onboarding tasks in Confluence.
- Implemented Lead Generation campaigns across industry verticals, increasing monthly MQLs by 40% and shortening average lead-to-opportunity time by 22% using CRM workflows.
- Partnered with product and compliance teams via Jira to accelerate contract turnaround, reducing average deal closure time by 15%.

Business Development Manager, Vertex Analytics (Apr 2023 - Apr 2024)
- Drove B2B Sales for analytics solutions, managing opportunities in SFDC and closing strategic deals worth INR 2.1 crore by focusing on enterprise lead generation.
- Designed a repeatable Lead Generation playbook and CRM segmentation that improved SQL conversion rate by 30% and reduced churn risk for pilot customers.
- Coordinated technical scoping and delivery handoffs using Confluence and Jira, and maintained versioned collateral in Git for sales enablement.

Sales Manager, PhonePe (Jun 2022 - Mar 2023)
- Managed merchant acquisition and B2B Sales initiatives, tracking pipeline and forecasts in SFDC and CRM to meet regional targets.
- Executed Lead Generation programs with channel partners, contributing to a 25% uplift in activation rates and streamlining follow-up processes via CRM automation.
- Documented playbooks and campaign retrospectives in Confluence and tracked implementation tasks in Jira.

Education
MBA (Marketing), IIM Indore
